name: What preparation is typically included in your rental property painting service?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is typically included in your rental property painting service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our rental property painting service in areas like Millbrae and San Mateo includes comprehensive preparation to ensure a quality finish. This typically involves protecting floors and furniture, minor wall repairs such as filling nail holes and small cracks, light sanding to create a smooth surface, and priming as needed. We meticulously tape off trim and edges to ensure clean lines. Our goal is to prepare each surface correctly to maximize paint adhesion and durability, providing a fresh look for your next tenants.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our service includes protecting surfaces, minor wall repairs, light sanding, and priming to ensure a high-quality, durable finish.
